points.point: Is the 100 MB Google Drive limit true?
points.sentence: Blotato does not impose a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff.

points.point: Drive keeps returning Google's virus scan warning page instead of the file (Drive warning page fix)
points.sentence: First, share the file as "Anyone with the link" and use https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=FILE_ID&export=download&confirm=t.

verdict.reason: The entry directly states that Blotato has no 100 MB Google Drive cutoff and gives the sharing and direct-download link fix for the warning page the customer is hitting, though the customer's account-specific failure cannot be confirmed from the sentences.
